tips.text: You can freeze food right up until midnight on the ‘use by’ date printed on the label.
If you cook food before the use-by date, you should then cool it and keep it in the fridge. You must then eat it within 48 hours or freeze it to eat at a later date.
Overripe fruit is great for cooking, baking and made into smoothies.
You can freeze cooked or parboiled potatoes which have been boiled for 5 minutes.
